entries.title: Philippians 2:1
segments: ¶Therefore if [there is] any consolation in Christ, if any comfort of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any affection and mercy,

entries.title: Philippians 2:2
segments: fulfill my joy by being like-minded, having the same love, [being] of one accord, of one mind.

entries.title: Philippians 2:3
segments: [Let] nothing [be done] through selfish ambition or conceit, but in lowliness of mind let each esteem others better than himself.

entries.title: Philippians 2:4
segments: Let each of you look out not only for his own interests, but also for the interests of others.

entries.title: Philippians 2:5
segments: Let this mind be in you which was also in Christ Jesus,

entries.title: Philippians 2:6
segments: who, being in the form of God, did not consider it robbery to be equal with God,

entries.title: Philippians 2:7
segments: but made Himself of no reputation, taking the form of a bondservant, [and] coming in the likeness of men.

entries.title: Philippians 2:8
segments: And being found in appearance as a man, He humbled Himself and became obedient to [the point of] death, even the death of the cross.

entries.title: Philippians 2:9
segments: Therefore God also has highly exalted Him and given Him the name which is above every name,

entries.title: Philippians 2:10
segments: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of those in heaven, and of those on earth, and of those under the earth,

entries.title: Philippians 2:11
segments: and [that] every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ [is] Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

entries.title: Philippians 2:12
segments: ¶Therefore, my beloved, as you have always obeyed, not as in my presence only, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling;

entries.title: Philippians 2:13
segments: for it is God who works in you both to will and to do for [His] good pleasure.

entries.title: Philippians 2:14
segments: ¶Do all things without complaining and disputing,

entries.title: Philippians 2:15
segments: that you may become blameless and harmless, children of God without fault in the midst of a crooked and perverse generation, among whom you shine as lights in the world,

entries.title: Philippians 2:16
segments: holding fast the word of life, so that I may rejoice in the day of Christ that I have not run in vain or labored in vain.

entries.title: Philippians 2:17
segments: Yes, and if I am being poured out [as a drink offering] on the sacrifice and service of your faith, I am glad and rejoice with you all.

entries.title: Philippians 2:18
segments: For the same reason you also be glad and rejoice with me.

entries.title: Philippians 2:19
segments: But I trust in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you shortly, that I also may be encouraged when I know your state.

entries.title: Philippians 2:20
segments: For I have no one like-minded, who will sincerely care for your state.

entries.title: Philippians 2:21
segments: For all seek their own, not the things which are of Christ Jesus.

entries.title: Philippians 2:22
segments: But you know his proven character, that as a son with [his] father he served with me in the gospel.

entries.title: Philippians 2:23
segments: Therefore I hope to send him at once, as soon as I see how it goes with me.

entries.title: Philippians 2:24
segments: But I trust in the Lord that I myself shall also come shortly.

entries.title: Philippians 2:25
segments: Yet I considered it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, fellow worker, and fellow soldier, but your messenger and the one who ministered to my need;

entries.title: Philippians 2:26
segments: since he was longing for you all, and was distressed because you had heard that he was sick.

entries.title: Philippians 2:27
segments: For indeed he was sick almost unto death; but God had mercy on him, and not only on him but on me also, lest I should have sorrow upon sorrow.

entries.title: Philippians 2:28
segments: Therefore I sent him the more eagerly, that when you see him again you may rejoice, and I may be less sorrowful.

entries.title: Philippians 2:29
segments: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all gladness, and hold such men in esteem;

entries.title: Philippians 2:30
segments: because for the work of Christ he came close to death, not regarding his life, to supply what was lacking in your service toward me.
